description: This file implements the ProcessInfo class and related functionalities for process management, including platform-specific methods for retrieving process details, memory usage, and process trees within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents a process, providing methods to retrieve process details, memory usage, command line, and process hierarchy.

classes.name: ProcessInfo::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class to traverse processes based on various criteria such as name, parent process, or child processes.

classes.name: ProcessInfo::Memory
classes.description: Encapsulates memory statistics for a process, including resident, shared, and virtual memory.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a process hierarchy tree, allowing traversal and querying of process relationships.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Provides information and management functions for the current process.

methods.name: Allocated
methods.description: Returns the amount of allocated memory for the process.

methods.name: Resident
methods.description: Returns the resident memory size of the process.

methods.name: Shared
methods.description: Returns the shared memory size of the process.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the executable name of the process.

methods.name: Executable
methods.description: Returns the full path of the process executable.

methods.name: CommandLine
methods.description: Returns the command line arguments used to start the process.

methods.name: FindByName
methods.description: Finds processes matching a given name.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Returns the username of the process owner.

methods.name: User (setter)
methods.description: Sets the user ID for the process.

methods.name: SupplementryGroups
methods.description: Sets supplementary groups for the process.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Returns the group name of the process owner.

methods.name: Group (setter)
methods.description: Sets the group ID for the process.

methods.name: ContainsProcess
methods.description: Checks if the process tree contains a process with a specific ID.

methods.name: GetProcessIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of process IDs in the process tree.

methods.name: RootId
methods.description: Returns the root process ID of the process tree.

methods.name: Memory::Memory
methods.description: Constructor initializing memory statistics for a process.

methods.name: Memory::Memory (copy constructor)
methods.description: Copies memory statistics from another Memory object.

methods.name: Memory::operator=
methods.description: Assigns memory statistics from another Memory object.

methods.name: MemoryStats
methods.description: Reads and updates memory statistics from /proc/<pid>/smaps.
